name: Force Sight
description: Allows perception of the world through the Force, bypassing blindness, illusions, or even physical obstructions like smoke or darkness.

levels.effect: You can perceive the world through the Force, bypassing blindness, illusions, and normal darkness within 25 yards. You gain 360-degree vision.
Range extends to 50 yards. You can detect living beings through thin objects within 5 yards. Gain +1 to Perception to detect hidden opponents.
Range extends to 100 yards. You can see through heavier objects within 10 yards. Gain +2 to defend against surprise attacks.
Range is limitless in a Force-rich environment. You can discern emotional states and immediate intentions within 50 yards. You can no longer be surprised.

name: Farsight
description: The Force-user can extend their senses beyond normal limits, perceiving events and locations at great distances through the Force, as if physically present.

levels.effect: Project senses to a familiar location within 100 miles for 1 minute.
Project senses to any location on the same planet for 5 minutes.
Project senses to any location within the same star system for 10 minutes.
Project senses to a neighboring star system for 30 minutes. Can perform rudimentary Perception rolls in the viewed area.

name: Precognition
description: The Force-user receives glimpses or warnings of future events, providing insight into impending danger, important developments, or potential outcomes.

levels.effect: Receive vague premonitions of immediate danger (seconds to minutes).
Premonitions become clearer, foreshadowing events within the next hour.
Receive premonitions of significant events occurring within the next day.
Experience powerful premonitions of major events spanning days to weeks. Provides a permanent +1 bonus to all Danger Sense rolls.

name: Psychometry
description: The Force-user can perceive echoes of the past by touching an object or entering a location where strong emotions or significant events have occurred.

levels.effect: By touching an object with a strong, recent history, you gain vague sensory hints of its past for 1 minute.
Gain clearer impressions and specific details from objects with a significant history for up to 5 minutes.
Project your senses into past events you perceive, experiencing them as if present for up to 10 minutes.
Witness any event related to a person or location by concentrating on them, even without direct physical contact, for up to 30 minutes.

name: Force Concealment
description: The user masks their presence in the Force, making them difficult for other Force-sensitives to detect.
baseSkill: Stealth (DX/Average) or a contested Sense roll

levels.effect: You can hide your Force signature. Other Force-sensitives must win a Quick Contest of Sense vs. your Stealth to detect you. Costs 1 FP per 10 min to maintain.
You impose a -2 penalty on any Sense roll to detect your presence. You can extend this concealment to one willing adjacent person. Costs 1 FP per 30 min.
You impose a -4 penalty on detection rolls. You can conceal a small group (up to 3 people) in a 2-yard radius. Costs 1 FP per hour.
You are completely invisible to Force senses unless you use an overt Force power. You can conceal a group of up to 5 people. Costs 1 FP per hour.

name: Force Push/Pull
description: The Force-user can telekinetically push or pull objects and beings.

levels.effect: Exert a telekinetic force equal to your Basic Lift (BL) on objects within 10 yards. Cannot inflict damage directly.
Force increases to 2xBL within 20 yards. Can attempt to disarm an opponent or push/pull a person, causing them to fall prone.
Force increases to 4xBL within 50 yards. Can inflict 1d-3 crushing damage with thrown objects, or 1d on a pushed person.
Force increases to 8xBL within 100 yards. Can hurl a person up to 5 yards, causing 2d crushing damage.

name: Force Jump/Leap
description: The Force-user enhances their physical jump or leap through an application of the Force.

levels.effect: Double your effective Jumping skill distance.
Triple your effective Jumping skill distance.
Quadruple your effective Jumping skill distance. Can perform a "Force-assisted pounce" attack.
Multiply your effective Jumping skill distance by five. Can use for "Controlled Descent" to negate falling damage.

name: Force Speed
description: The Force-user accelerates their body and mind, allowing them to move and react with incredible swiftness.

levels.effect: Gain +2 to Basic Move and +0.5 Basic Speed for 1d turns.
Gain +4 to Basic Move and +1.0 Basic Speed for 1d+1 turns. Gain +1 to Active Defenses.
Gain +6 to Basic Move and +1.5 Basic Speed for 1d+2 turns. Gain +2 to Active Defenses and one extra attack per turn.
Gain +8 to Basic Move and +2.0 Basic Speed for 1d+3 turns. Gain +3 to Active Defenses and two extra attacks per turn at a -1 penalty.

name: Force Barrier
description: The Force-user creates a protective shield of pure energy to deflect or absorb incoming attacks.

levels.effect: Create a personal barrier with DR 5 against one incoming attack. (1 FP/turn to maintain)
Project a stationary wall or a bubble around yourself and an ally with DR 10. (2 FP/turn to maintain)
Create a defensive bubble up to 5 yards in radius with DR 15. (2 FP/turn to maintain)
Manifest a nearly impenetrable dome up to 10 yards in radius with DR 25. (3 FP/turn to maintain)

name: Force Rage
description: The user channels their anger and pain into a terrifying surge of physical power, sacrificing defense for raw offensive capability.

levels.effect: For 1 minute, you gain +2 ST, but suffer -1 to all Active Defenses. You must make a self-control roll to avoid attacking the nearest target (friend or foe).
For 1 minute, you gain +3 ST and +1 HT, but suffer -2 to all Active Defenses. Self-control roll is at +1.
For 1 minute, you gain +4 ST, +2 HT, and +1 to Basic Speed, but cannot Parry. Self-control roll is at +2.
For 1 minute, you gain +5 ST, +3 HT, +1 to Basic Speed, and DR 2 (Tough Skin). You cannot use Active Defenses. Self-control roll is at +4.

name: Force Mind Trick
description: The Force-user subtly influences the minds of others, planting suggestions, causing confusion, or altering perceptions.

levels.effect: (Influence) Plant a simple, non-harmful suggestion in one non-Force-sensitive being within 5 yards. Requires a Quick Contest of skill vs. Will.
(Force Persuasion) Plant a more complex suggestion or alter a minor perception. Range increases to 10 yards. Can target up to two beings.
(Peaceful Resolution) Compel a simple, non-suicidal action. Range increases to 20 yards. Can target up to three beings, or one Force-sensitive at a penalty.
(Create Illusion) Create minor hallucinations or compel complex actions. Range is 50 yards. Can target up to five beings.

name: Force Lightning
description: The Force-user generates raw electrical energy from their fingertips, unleashing potent bolts of Force lightning upon their foes.

levels.effect: (Sith Spark) Project a single bolt at a target within 10 yards, inflicting 1d burning damage.
(Forked Lightning) Project a more potent bolt within 20 yards, inflicting 2d burning damage. Can be maintained as a continuous stream.
(Lightning Conduit) Project a torrent within 30 yards, inflicting 3d burning damage. Can chain to hit up to 3 targets.
(Force Storm) Unleash a devastating surge within 50 yards, inflicting 4d burning damage, or a 3-yard cone for 2d damage.

name: Force Shock
description: The Force-user can project a concentrated burst of Force energy that stuns or incapacitates a single target.

levels.effect: Target within 5 yards suffers a -1 penalty to DX-based rolls and Active Defenses for 1 turn.
Range increases to 10 yards. Target suffers a -2 penalty for 1d turns and loses 1 EP.
Range increases to 20 yards. Target suffers a -3 penalty for 1d+1 turns and loses 2 EP.
Range increases to 30 yards. Target suffers a -4 penalty for 1d+2 turns, loses 3 EP, and must make a HT roll or fall unconscious.

name: Force Storm
description: The Force-user conjures a devastating localized storm of Force energy, unleashing a torrent of destructive power upon an area.

levels.effect: Create a 1-yard radius sphere within 10 yards, inflicting 1d crushing damage.
Expands to a 2-yard radius sphere within 20 yards, inflicting 2d crushing damage.
Expands to a 3-yard radius sphere within 30 yards, inflicting 3d crushing damage.
Expands to a 5-yard radius sphere within 50 yards, inflicting 4d crushing damage.

name: Force Scream
description: An uncontrolled, raw release of Force energy triggered by extreme anger, pain, or frustration.

levels.effect: All beings within a 3-yard radius must make a HT roll or be mentally stunned for 1 turn.
All targets in a 5-yard radius suffer 1d crushing damage and must make a HT-1 roll or be knocked prone.
Radius increases to 8 yards, inflicts 2d crushing damage, and all targets must make a HT-2 roll or be stunned for 1d turns.
Radius increases to 12 yards, inflicts 3d crushing damage, and may temporarily deafen those who fail a HT-3 roll.

name: Drain Force
description: A potent Dark Side ability, this power allows the Force-user to siphon the life energy and Force potential of another being.

levels.effect: Drain 1d-1 EP from a target within 5 yards; you regain half.
Drain 1d EP and 1d FP from a target within 15 yards; you regain half.
Inflict 1d-2 fatigue damage to a target within 25 yards, healing HP equal to damage dealt.
Create a 5-yard radius field that deals 1d fatigue damage to all within; you heal HP equal to the total damage dealt.

name: Drain Life
description: One of the most sinister Dark Side powers, Drain Life allows the user to violently rip a target's life force away to mend their own body.

levels.effect: (Siphon Stamina) By touch, inflict 1d-3 HP of injury that bypasses DR, and you heal for the exact amount lost.
(Siphon Life) Range extends to 10 yards. Inflicts 1d-1 HP of injury, healing you for the amount lost.
(Contagious Drain) Range increases to 25 yards. Inflicts 1d HP of injury, healing you for the amount lost.
(Area of Suffering) Range extends to 50 yards. Inflicts 2d-2 HP of injury, healing you for the amount lost.

name: Force Fear
description: The user projects a wave of terror into the minds of their enemies, causing them to flee or become paralyzed with fear.
baseSkill: Intimidation (Will/Average) or a contested Will roll.

levels.effect: Target one being within 10 yards. They must make an immediate Fright Check.
Affect up to 3 targets within a 2-yard radius. They must make a Fright Check at -1.
Affect all targets in a 5-yard cone. They must make a Fright Check at -2.
Affect all targets in a 10-yard radius. They must make a Fright Check at -3. Those who critically fail are paralyzed with fear for 1d turns.

name: Force Choke
description: A terrifying display of power where the user telekinetically constricts the throat of a target, cutting off their air supply.

levels.effect: (Constriction) Target one being within 10 yards. On a successful contested roll, they begin to suffocate and take 1 point of fatigue damage per second.
Range increases to 20 yards. The target takes 2 points of fatigue damage per second and is at -2 to DX.
Range increases to 30 yards. The target takes 1d-2 crushing damage per second in addition to suffocation.
Range increases to 50 yards. The target takes 1d crushing damage per second and is completely immobilized.

name: Force Heal
description: The Force-user channels life-giving energy through the Force to accelerate natural healing.

levels.effect: (Mend Injury) Stabilize a dying character or remove 1 point of injury penalty.
(Restore Life) Restore 1 HP to a target. Can cure minor illnesses.
(Purge Poison/Disease) Restore 2 HP to a target. Can cure moderate illnesses or poisons.
(Area of Healing) Restore 3 HP to a target. Can perform 'Regenerative Healing.'

name: Force Revitalize
description: A subtle but potent application of the Force, allowing the user to channel healing energies to mend fatigue and restore stamina.

levels.effect: By touch, restore 2 EP to a target.
Restore 4 EP to a target within 2 yards.
Restore 8 EP to a target within 5 yards, or affect up to two allies for 4 EP each.
Instantly restore all lost EP to a single target you touch, or restore 6 EP to a group of up to five allies.
